history.summary: IDENTITY NOTE: 'Sri Venkateshwara Swamy Temple' is a generic name with dozens of candidates across the twin cities, so this is the best-supported referent rather than a certain match. The best-supported referent is the Sri Venkateshwara Swamy Temple at 1-9-25, Kushaiguda Road, Kushaiguda Industrial Area, Kushaiguda, Secunderabad (Telangana 500062) - it carries the exact CSV name, sits in Secunderabad, and has a dedicated web listing describing a 40+ year-old temple on the Kushaiguda main road with sub-shrines for Venkateswara, Goda Devi, Padmavathy and Hanuman, a gosala, large open space and an auditorium for functions. The temple is in Kushaiguda, which lies in Medchal-Malkajgiri district (geocoder county) though it is administratively within the Secunderabad urban area - the district is corrected to Medchal-Malkajgiri while the town is kept as Secunderabad (Kushaiguda). Alternate candidate: the famous Birla Mandir on Naubat Pahad (Khairtabad, HYDERABAD, not Secunderabad), dedicated to Lord Venkateswara with an 11-ft granite idol, built by the Birla Foundation 1966-1976 and opened in 1976 - documented as the alternative if the CSV intends the prominent Venkateswara temple of the region. Do not merge with the Tirumala (seq 16) or Venkatapalem (seq 5) entries - distinct shrines.

name: Sri Venkateshwara Swamy Temple (Kushaiguda, Secunderabad) [provisional identity]
town_description: Kushaiguda is a locality in the Secunderabad area on the northeastern side of the twin cities, in Medchal-Malkajgiri district, Telangana. The temple stands on the Kushaiguda main road (500062) and is known locally for its spacious premises and function auditorium.
